statusVocabulary.NOT_RUN: No run on the final lane revision has been recorded yet; the status of every row that no open gate blocks.
statusVocabulary.BLOCKED: An open decision gate (plan Section 3) or a missing machine prevents a valid run; the row carries a blocker with gate, owner and reason. G8-A10 is BLOCKED(G8-D3) until G8-18 is done.
statusVocabulary.PASS: A run recorded on the final revision whose evidence record has result PASS, a matching fixture hash and an artifact. No row is PASS in this slice.
statusVocabulary.FAIL: A run recorded on the final revision whose evidence record has result FAIL. No row is FAIL in this slice.

rowRules: One row per requirement id in spec Section 9.1: G5-A01..G5-A08, G6-A01..G6-A10, G7-A01..G7-A05, plus G8-A01..G8-A10 from the G8 addendum (plan Section 5.7 acceptance table, UNI-1331/UNI-1328), plus FD-A01..FD-A12 = AC-01..AC-12 of UNI-1425 (plan Section 5.8 acceptance table, epic E6).
fixtures[] name a manifest id and repeat that manifest entry's sha256; the sibling test reads the hash from the manifest and never hardcodes it.
A row is PASS only with an evidence record whose result is PASS, exit code 0, an artifact on disk and one record per fixture it names; a result other than PASS is never counted as PASS.
Every row carries evidenceRequired: the artifacts and records that would prove it, so a row without an evidence plan fails even while it is NOT_RUN.

partialEvidence is optional and additive: a list of {task, revision, run, report, review, tests} naming what one task already proved on a revision. It is not an evidence record and never moves a row off NOT_RUN; only a PASS record per fixture does.
A BLOCKED row carries blocker.gate (plan Section 3), blocker.owner and blocker.reason.
gate records the open decision gate that affects the row even when the row is NOT_RUN; null when no gate affects it.
acceptance.md repeats these rows cell for cell; the sibling test fails on any drift between the two, and it recomputes the count table and the open-gate section from these rows.
The sibling test reads the runner ledger only when OFFICE_EVIDENCE_LEDGER names it; evidenceLedger above is the path the runner writes, never read implicitly (it is gitignored).

rows.title: Snapshot nhiều trang + concurrent writers + retention không mất thay đổi; cursor tiến qua sự kiện bị lọc

oracle.assertion: Assert the paged snapshot is consistent at its high-water mark, a commit that lands between the snapshot and the first feed page appears exactly once, retention never drops a change the client has not acknowledged, and a cursor advances past a page whose events are all filtered.

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on fx-xlsx-revenue-xyz and one on fx-docx-report-vi with result PASS, each with its artifact, plus the change-feed receipts for the concurrent-writer and retention cases.
negativeCases: A commit that lands between the snapshot and the first feed page must not be lost or delivered twice.
A page made only of filtered events must not leave the cursor stuck, and an expired cursor must answer change_cursor_expired instead of a partial page.
Retention must never drop a change the client has not acknowledged.

rows.title: Grant/revoke/tombstone/move/Work Product ACL không lộ metadata và không resurrect file

oracle.assertion: Assert the incremental feed leaks no metadata of a document the caller lost access to, a revocation removal payload carries ids and revision only, and a tombstone never resurrects an archived or deleted document.

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on fx-docx-report-vi and one on fx-md-notes-vi with result PASS, each with its artifact, plus the ACL removal payloads showing ids and revision only.
negativeCases: A grant, revoke, move, archive or restore must not leak a title, name or metadata the caller may no longer read.
A tombstone must not resurrect a deleted document on a later page.
A Work Product ACL fan-out must not create a private ACL of its own while the C-14 owner resolver is absent.

rows.title: Web lưu → desktop nhận và desktop lưu → web nhận, cùng version/checksum; dirty editor không bị thay

oracle.assertion: Assert both directions of a cross-host save land on the same version id and checksum, and a dirty editor is never replaced by the incoming version.

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on fx-xlsx-revenue-xyz and one on fx-docx-report-vi with result PASS from both hosts, each with its artifact, plus the version ids and checksums the two hosts report.
negativeCases: A web save must not reach the desktop app as a different version or checksum.
An incoming version must not overwrite or silently discard a dirty editor buffer.
A missed realtime event must be recovered from the change feed rather than left as a silent divergence.

rows.title: Offline pin đủ file/assets/checksum; interrupted download/disk full/corrupt cache không báo ready giả

oracle.assertion: Assert the offline pin holds every declared file, asset and checksum, and an interrupted download, a full disk or a corrupt cache never reports the library as ready.

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on fx-pdf-invoice-vi and one on fx-html-page-vi with result PASS, each with its artifact, plus the pin manifest of files, assets and checksums the app resolved.
negativeCases: An interrupted download, a disk-full write or a corrupt cache must not mark the pin ready.
A missing asset or a checksum mismatch must fail the pin instead of being served from a partial cache.
An offline capability that a gate has not approved must not be enabled by a passing local run.

blocker.reason: The offline lease policy needs the approved DOC-005 amendment and threat model; until it is approved the offline capability stays off, so this row cannot run and is BLOCKED(G5-D1).

rows.title: Save offline → crash/restart → reconnect: một receipt/version; N+1 còn dirty, không tự lưu

oracle.assertion: Assert one offline save that survives a crash and a restart produces exactly one receipt and one version after reconnect, and an edit made while the save runs stays dirty.

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on fx-docx-report-vi with result PASS and its artifact, plus the receipt and version rows the reconnect produced after the crash.
negativeCases: A crash or restart between the local checkpoint and the commit must not create a second version or a duplicate receipt.
An edit made while save N runs (N+1) must not be submitted with N's payload or auto-saved on reconnect.
A queue limit that the G5-D3 spine decision has not fixed must not be treated as an approved limit.

rows.title: Expired upload/idempotency, timeout-after-commit, cancel race và late response không duplicate/overwrite

oracle.assertion: Assert an expired upload, a timeout after commit, a cancel race and a late response each reconcile to one version with no duplicate upload and no overwrite.

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on fx-xlsx-revenue-xyz with result PASS and its artifact, plus the version and upload rows each of the four race cases reconciled to.
negativeCases: A timeout after commit must not produce a second version or a second upload of the same bytes.
A cancel race or a late response must not overwrite a newer version or resurrect a fenced attempt.
An intent lookup whose retention window has been purged must answer unknown with its own code, never a fabricated not-committed.

rows.title: Lease/expiry/clock rollback/revoke/logout A→B/deployment switch/keystore lock đúng policy được duyệt

oracle.assertion: Assert an expired lease, a rolled-back clock, a revocation, a logout A to B, a deployment switch and a locked keystore each follow the approved policy with no plaintext left behind.

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on fx-docx-report-vi with result PASS and its artifact, plus the lease decisions and the keystore state for each policy case.
negativeCases: A rolled-back clock or an expired lease must not extend offline rights beyond the approved policy.
A logout A to B or a deployment switch must not leave account A's key, plaintext or ciphertext readable by B.
A locked keystore must block the save path instead of degrading to an unprotected store.

blocker.reason: The lease, expiry and clock-rollback rules are exactly what the unapproved DOC-005 amendment and threat model define, so the lease half of this row cannot run and the row is BLOCKED(G5-D1).

rows.title: Conflict giữ hai bản, copy giữ owner/ACL/provenance; queue cancel không mất nháp

oracle.assertion: Assert a conflict keeps both copies with the copy retaining owner, ACL and provenance, and cancelling a queued intent loses no draft.

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on fx-xlsx-revenue-xyz and one on fx-pptx-deck-vi with result PASS, each with its artifact, plus both conflicting copies with their owner, ACL and provenance.
negativeCases: A conflict must not overwrite or delete either copy, and the losing side must not rebase a binary automatically.
A downloaded or copied copy must not lose its owner, ACL or provenance.
Cancelling a queued intent must not discard the draft or the local checkpoint.

rows.title: XLSX xác định đúng sheet/range/types/filters; phép tính toàn phạm vi đúng oracle, không dựa sample

oracle.assertion: Assert the resolved sheet, range, cell types and filters match the workbook oracle, and a whole-range calculation matches the ground truth rather than a sampled subset.

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on fx-xlsx-revenue-xyz with result PASS and its artifact, plus the resolved sheet, range, cell types and filters the score compares with the oracle.
negativeCases: A sampled or cached range must not be scored as a whole-range calculation.
Z stored as the plain number 10 and as 10% (0.1) must both be read as a 10 percent discount, and a blank Z as no discount.
Hidden rows and the two totals rows must be resolved per the oracle instead of being treated as absent.

rows.title: Yêu cầu mơ hồ hỏi lại; unsupported formula, cache stale, blank/error/locale/rounding được xử lý rõ

oracle.assertion: Assert an ambiguous request asks back, an unsupported formula is refused with its reason, a stale calculation cache is not used as the answer, and blank, error, locale and rounding cases resolve as the case declares.

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on fx-xlsx-revenue-xyz with result PASS and its artifact, plus the ask-back question and the refusal reasons the ambiguous and unsupported cases returned.
negativeCases: An ambiguous request must not be answered with a guess instead of a clarification question.
A stale cached formula value must not be reported as the computed answer.
An error cell (#DIV/0!, #N/A, #REF!) must not be silently replaced by zero or by a fabricated value.

rows.title: Một lượt AI (mọi nhà cung cấp) không tạo upload/version/save intent; chỉ thao tác Lưu của người dùng mới commit

oracle.assertion: Assert the server version count is unchanged and no save intent is created after a full AI turn for every provider, and only an explicit user Save commits.

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on fx-xlsx-revenue-xyz and one on fx-docx-report-vi with result PASS, each with its artifact, plus the version count and the save intents the server recorded after each AI turn.
negativeCases: An AI turn must not upload bytes, create a version or create a save intent, on any provider.
An AI turn must not call the commit route even when the tool wrote into the editor.
A provider error or a stopped run must not be retried into an implicit save.

rows.title: Thay đổi do AI nhìn thấy được và hoàn tác được trước khi Lưu; Lưu sau AI đúng `base_revision`, 409 giữ bản cục bộ, double click/retry không nhân đôi version

oracle.assertion: Assert an AI change is visible and undoable before Save, the Save after an AI turn uses the current base_revision, a 409 keeps the local copy, and a double click or a retry does not create a second version.

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on fx-docx-report-vi and one on fx-xlsx-revenue-xyz with result PASS, each with its artifact, plus the base_revision of the Save and the 409 outcome.
negativeCases: An AI change must not be committed without an explicit user Save.
A Save after an AI turn must not send a stale base_revision or auto-rebase on a 409.
A double click or a retry of the same Save must not create a second version.

rows.title: DOCX mở → AI sửa trong editor → người dùng xem và Lưu → version mới → tải và mở Word; version cũ checksum không đổi

oracle.assertion: Assert the AI edit round-trips through the DOCX validator, a new version appears only after the user Save, the file opens in Word, and the previous version's checksum is unchanged.

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on fx-docx-report-vi with result PASS and its artifact, plus the validator output, the new version and the unchanged checksum of the previous one.
negativeCases: A missing OOXML part or a broken round trip must not be reported as accepted.
The previous version's checksum must not change after the new commit.
A Word open failure must be recorded as a blocker instead of being waived.

rows.title: Các format còn lại theo §6.5, có oracle structure/render và giới hạn capability đúng host (web frame / desktop)

oracle.assertion: Assert every remaining Section 6.5 format has a structure or render oracle per host, and a format without a capability is refused on that host rather than shown as disabled.

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on each of fx-pptx-deck-vi, fx-pdf-invoice-vi, fx-md-notes-vi and fx-html-page-vi with result PASS, each with its artifact, plus the structure or render oracle per host.
negativeCases: A missing format, slide, page or heading count must stay measured and blocked rather than called pass.
A capability the host does not hold must be absent, not a disabled control that implies it exists.
A client-only pass must not be cited to close a host whose capability is missing.

rows.title: Entitlement/frame token/ACL mất quyền giữa chừng/cross-org/cross-workspace/prompt injection/history replay đều được chặn; UniWork AI ẩn khi không đủ điều kiện và hiện khi chỉ có `uniworkAi` (không BYOK); tool call ngoài allowlist bị từ chối; vượt trần lượt trả `run_limit_reached`; system prompt/instruction pack do server giữ, client không thay được

oracle.assertion: Assert each probe is refused: a revoked entitlement or ACL mid-run, a stale frame token, a cross-organization or cross-workspace run id, a client-supplied system or assistant turn, a prompt-injection payload, a replayed history, and a tool call outside the allowlist; the run limit answers run_limit_reached; and the panel is hidden while UniWork AI is not eligible and appears on uniworkAi alone with no BYOK.

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on fx-docx-report-vi and one on fx-xlsx-revenue-xyz with result PASS, each with its artifact, plus the refusal code of every probe and the panel state with and without uniworkAi.
negativeCases: A client-supplied system or assistant turn must never reach the model, and an inflated tool result must be ignored in favour of the server transcript.
A run id of another user, organization, workspace or document must be refused, and a revoked or downgraded permission must drop write tools from the next turn.
A tool call outside the allowlist must be dropped with its reason and never reach the client as a usable call.
Text inside a document, a cell or a tool result that tells the model to ignore its instructions or call a tool must not change the run, and the server transcript must stay unchanged by it.

rows.title: Từng lượt gọi model có attribution/quota/usage; unknown usage được reconcile, không bỏ sót

oracle.assertion: Assert every model call in a run carries attribution, quota and usage; a disconnect mid-run still records usage; and a provider that returns no usage lands as unknown with a reconciliation row counted once.

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on fx-xlsx-revenue-xyz with result PASS and its artifact, plus the usage rows with attribution and quota, and the reconciliation row counted once.
negativeCases: A client disconnect or a kill switch mid-run must still record the usage already spent.
A retry under the same run id must not record usage twice.
Missing upstream usage must be recorded as unknown and reconciled exactly once, never dropped or invented.

rows.title: Instruction pack có version: mỗi lượt truy được `prompt_id` + provider/model đã resolve; đổi version hoặc rollback không làm model gọi/nhắc công cụ ngoài allowlist hay bịa công cụ (U-12 thay nội dung corpus/retrieval cũ)

oracle.assertion: Assert a run's usage line carries prompt_id and the resolved provider and model, every tool name the pack mentions exists in the genoffice tool table, and a version change or rollback never makes the model name a tool outside the allowlist or invent one.

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on fx-xlsx-revenue-xyz and one on fx-docx-report-vi with result PASS, each with its artifact, plus the prompt_id, provider and model of the usage line and the tool names against the genoffice table.

The pack must not name a tool that the genoffice tool table does not list.
Changing the pack content without bumping its version must fail, and a rollback must not reintroduce a tool outside the allowlist.

rows.title: Full loop: web edit-save → mở bằng app từ web → desktop offline edit-save → reconnect → web thấy version → AI sửa + Lưu → hai host thấy cùng kết quả

oracle.assertion: Assert the loop closes through the harness on the real stack: a web edit-save, opening the app from web, a desktop offline edit-save, a reconnect that lets web see the version, and an AI turn plus Save all leave both hosts on the same result; the version count grows by exactly one per user Save and by zero per AI turn and the final checksum is identical on both hosts.

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on fx-xlsx-revenue-xyz and one on fx-docx-report-vi with result PASS through the harness on the real stack, each with its artifact, plus the version count per Save and the checksum both hosts report.
negativeCases: A step that cannot run must be recorded as BLOCKED, never folded into a PASS for the whole loop.
A web-only or fake-provider run must not close this row.
A checksum divergence between the two hosts must fail the row instead of being reported as a delay.

rows.title: Lượt AI đang chạy gặp G5 remote update/conflict/revoke; kết quả không tự áp lên bản mới, revoke chặn lượt gọi tiếp

rows.evidenceRequired: A recorded run on fx-xlsx-revenue-xyz and one on fx-docx-report-vi with result PASS, each with its artifact, plus the base each late AI result was refused against and the 403 of the next turn after a revocation.
negativeCases: An AI result must not be auto-applied over a newer remote version.
A conflict during an AI turn must not silently overwrite either side.
A revoked permission must block the next AI turn instead of letting it run and fail late.

rows.title: Upgrade/rollback bản dev, namespace/key/store migration; file cục bộ không gọi mạng khi chưa đăng nhập; signed update/tamper/wrong channel chỉ khi mở backlog chứng chỉ (U-11)

Opening a local file while signed out must send zero network requests.
A signed-update, tamper or wrong-channel case must not be claimed while the certificate backlog is closed.
